correctness.rationale: Positive diagonal moments give exact constraints d_j>=-alpha and L_n(j)=Σ_{h=0}^{n-2}(n-1-h)d_{j+h}<=beta. Rearrangement using lower bounds on future increments yields upper K. The explicit increment pulse at j* with n-1 preceding and n-2 following entries -alpha has every window budget <=beta, attaining K; isolated negative step attains -alpha. A smooth finite ramp of w from 1/2 to 1 has defect O(1/N) and best sup-norm distance 1/4 to scalar S, disproving uniform global stability. Independent rational pulse/window checks succeeded for 52 n/error instances.
